# dsh-changelog-panel
简体中文

> Primary repo: <https://github.com/HLhhh/dsh-changelog-panel> ·
> Gitee mirror: <https://gitee.com/
huang-lin-java/dsh-changelog-panel>
**A bilingual changelog and security-advisory panel for DeepSeek Harness.** Install it and the sideb

ar
gains one entry: what changed in every release, and which CVE/GHSA records affect your install.

- Version timeline with category-grouped feature cards and keyword search
- A **Security** tab: 13 a

dvisories with severity, affected range, fixed version, and source links
- An installed-version badg

e that tells you how it compares to the official latest
- Per-panel language switch (zh / en) that n
either follows nor changes the rest of the shell
## What it looks like
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Install / Update
> Not published to npm yet — install straight from GitHub.
### With the `dsh` CLI
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `web` with your profile name (`desktop` for the desktop app).
### With the `plugin_manager` tool (inside an agent)
Call `install_bundle` with `target` set to:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### From a local checkout
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The prebuilt `lib/client.js` is committed, so **no build step is required to install**.
Restart DSH
(or let HMR pick it up) and refresh the page.
Uninstall:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Features
### Changelog

- Version timeline on the left, opening on the version **you actually have installed**
- Entries gro

uped by category: agent, UI, tools, sessions, security, platform, plugins
- Search across titles, su

mmaries, and related package names
- At most 12 release entries rendered per version; older ones are
reachable from the timeline
### Security
- 13 advisories and CVE/GHSA records with severity, status, affected range, fixed version, and links
- A "search scope" note stating what was searched and what was not found — no unsupported claims
### Live data
The panel talks to two public endpoints **directly from your browser**; no third-party server is inv
nel talks to two public endpoints **directly from your browser**; no third-party server is involved:
| Source | Used for |

| `registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` | Version list and publish times |
| `api.github.com/re
pos/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases` | Official release notes |
- Refreshes once on the first open of each day, plus a manual refresh button with the last refresh t

ime
- New versions are merged into the timeline but never overwrite the verified built-in dataset
-
**Release notes are optional enrichment.** GitHub's unauthenticated API allows 60 requests/hour per

IP, so
quota exhaustion is ordinary (shared NAT makes it likely). The version list still comes from

npm and the
refresh still counts as successful; the panel says "release notes unavailable" instead o

f reporting an
error. Only both sources failing is an error, and the previous data is kept when ther

e is any.
- An unknown installed version is shown as unknown ("versions not comparable"); the panel

never substitutes
the version the bundle was built with. The running version is read at runtime (`In

fo.plist`, the app
manifest inside `app.asar`, or Electron's `app.getVersion()`).
## Configuration
None. Language is the panel's own state (the 中文 / EN toggle in its header); it follows the shell loc

ale by
default and only affects this panel.
## Compatibility
| Surface | Status |

| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.x` (developed and tested on `0.2.1-rc.5`) |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0

.0` |
| Platforms | Web (browser and desktop) |
| Dependencies | Only the peer dependency `@deepseek
-ai/cordis ~4.0.4`; no host package is bundled |
## Known limitations

- **No npm release yet** — GitHub or a local path only
- The built-in dataset is a point-in-time sna

pshot; use the manual refresh for current data
- Live notes need `api.github.com`; when it is rate-l

imited or unreachable the panel keeps working from npm
(versions only) and shows a localized notice
- Chinese entries are paraphrases, not quotations of the original advisories — consult the linked so

urces
for compliance decisions
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`lib/client.js` is generated — edit `src/` and rebuild; do not hand-edit the bundle.
